title: Python slot claim: claim_seq not upper-bounded at decode/construct — accepts >u32::MAX that Rust rejects (interop divergence)
description: Codereview finding (l1qw.20.5 edge pass, verified live with cbor2): python/src/lichen/gateway/slot_claim.py:251-253 (decode_cose) and :176-178 (__post_init__) check only 'type(claim_seq) is not int or claim_seq < 0'. cbor2 decodes major-type-0 uint 2**32 and tag-2 bignums to Python int, passing the guard. Rust bounds the same wire field: rust/lichen-gateway/src/slot.rs:590 u32::try_from(seq) -> MalformedClaim; bignums fail p.uint() outright. A validly-signed wire claim with claim_seq = 2**32 is fully accepted and cached by Python but rejected by Rust — cross-implementation verdict divergence on identical wire input. Now that claim_seq is the operative replay-gate value (l1qw.20.4 Rust / l1qw.20.5 Python), the divergence directly affects replay-state parity. Sender mirror trap: encode_claim_canonical (:310) emits unbounded claim_seq, so a Python gateway whose counter exceeds u32::MAX mints claims every Rust receiver drops as malformed. Fix: reject claim_seq > 0xFFFFFFFF in both __post_init__ and decode_cose; pin with a boundary test (2**32-1 accepted, 2**32 rejected) and a wire-level decode test. Related: project-LICHEN-worker6-1paw (wrap semantics AT u32::MAX, C side — distinct).
close_reason: Done. _MAX_CLAIM_SEQ=0xFFFFFFFF added; SlotClaim.__post_init__ and decode_cose both reject claim_seq > u32::MAX (and <0, non-int) with ClaimError, matching Rust's u32::try_from at slot.rs:590. Pins: construct-boundary test (2^32-1 accepted, 2^32 and -1 rejected) in test_slot_claim.py, and wire-level decode test in test_slot_claim_cose_vectors.py tampering payload key 6 of a real vector with 2^32 (u64-width) and 2^64+1 (tag-2 bignum) — both rejected. Sender mirror trap closed at the same boundary (construct-gated). 81 passed, 3 skipped (pre-existing divergence skips). 3x delegated codereview: correctness PASS, edge PASS, security PASS on the diff with one real finding on sibling fields filed as project-LICHEN-worker6-s61e (slots/superframe_epoch/expiry/ordinal upper bounds, out of scope here — distinct field set).
